title: Room for a New Pocketwire Advance — Credit Calculation Sheet
content:
The room for a new Pocketwire Advance is the tier's advance limit reduced by the remaining principal of the line's advances. The remaining principal of the line's advances is the principal disbursed on the line less the part of its repayments and waivers left after all of its booked fees are covered, never below zero. The largest advance is the room rounded down to a whole multiple of the tier's advance increment. The advance limit and the advance increment are the tier's figures in the Pocketwire Advance tier schedule.

## Quantities

| Quantity | Taken from | Definition |
|---|---|---|
| Principal disbursed | Every advance disbursed on the line | Total of their amounts |
| Fees booked | Every fee booked on the line | Total of their amounts |
| Repayments and waivers | Every repayment and every fee waiver on the line | Total of their amounts |
| Part left after fees | Repayments and waivers, fees booked | Repayments and waivers less fees booked, never below zero |
| Remaining principal | Principal disbursed, part left after fees | Principal disbursed less the part left after fees, never below zero |
| Room | Advance limit, remaining principal | Advance limit less remaining principal |
| Largest advance | Room, advance increment | Room rounded down to a whole multiple of the increment |

## Worked sheet (hypothetical line on Pocketwire Advance Standard: advance limit 200.00, increment 5.00)

| Step | Figure |
|---|---|
| Principal disbursed over three advances | 450.00 |
| Fees booked | 22.50 |
| Repayments and waivers | 380.00 |
| Part left after fees: 380.00 less 22.50 | 357.50 |
| Remaining principal: 450.00 less 357.50 | 92.50 |
| Room: 200.00 less 92.50 | 107.50 |
| Largest advance: 107.50 rounded down to a multiple of 5.00 | 105.00 |

## Edge figures (hypothetical)

- Repayments and waivers of 3.00 against fees booked of 5.00 leave no part after fees, so the whole principal disbursed remains; on Pocketwire Advance Basic (limit 100.00) with 100.00 disbursed, the room is 0.00 and the largest advance is 0.00.
- Repayments and waivers of 110.00 against 5.00 of fees and 100.00 disbursed leave 105.00 after fees; 100.00 less 105.00 is below zero, so the remaining principal is 0.00 and the room is the whole advance limit.
- A room of 142.50 on any tier rounds down to 140.00; a room of 140.00 stays 140.00.
